answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A forge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the mirror of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on invitation quota tree, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
